_meta.description: Age-decay (World Athletics 'month correction') applied to a performance's score based on how many whole months old it is, measured from the ranking date. Performances 12+ months old fall out of the rolling window entirely.
_meta.unit: deduction in points, subtracted from the performance score
_meta.source: Per project spec (-20/-40/-60 at 9/10/11 months). Edit if World Athletics' published month-correction differs.
